name: Nebraska
overview: Nebraska combines a refundable community-college property-tax credit with property-tax statement credits and a targeted homestead exemption.

programs.name: Community College Property Tax Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: Qualifying community-college property taxes paid, as computed from parcel records.
programs.formulaSummary: Use Form PTC and DOR parcel lookup for qualifying community-college taxes paid in 2025; excluded levies and existing property-tax credits reduce the eligible base.
programs.application: Form PTC with a Nebraska income-tax return; an amended PTCX is available for missed credits.
eligibilityNotes: Eligibility follows actual payment to the county treasurer.
A lessee paying the county directly may qualify; ordinary rent alone is not sufficient.
interactions: Do not count school-district taxes as an income-tax PTC credit after the 2024 change.
School-district relief now appears on property-tax statements.
programs.programYear: 2025 income-tax credit for qualifying community-college property taxes paid during 2025, usually levied for 2024.

programs.name: Homestead Exemption
programs.ageRule: Qualifying older, disabled and veteran categories; category-specific conditions apply.
programs.incomeLimits: Varies by category, filing status and annual table.
programs.maximumBenefit: Partial or full eligible-value exemption; county-average value and statutory limits apply.
programs.formulaSummary: Reduce taxable homestead value under the qualifying category and income/value tables.
programs.application: Form 458 and required income/disability documentation to the county assessor.
programs.programYear: 2025 exemption application rules and 2025 income tables.

programs.name: Real Property Tax Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: Varies with qualifying property and tax bill.
programs.formulaSummary: Allocate State funding using parcel credit-allocation valuation and the published annual rate; show credit separately on the property-tax statement.
programs.application: Applied through county assessment and treasury administration.
eligibilityNotes: All taxable real-property parcels generally qualify; land classification affects allocation.
interactions: Applied after homestead exemption, before the School District Property Tax Relief Credit.
Already lowers the amount due; do not add it to relief when the user supplied a net tax bill.

programs.name: School District Property Tax Relief Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: Varies with qualifying property and tax bill.
programs.formulaSummary: Apply the State-funded school-district relief calculation to eligible parcel school taxes and display it as a credit on the tax statement.
eligibilityNotes: Use the tax-year-specific published calculation and qualifying school levies.
interactions: Coordinates with homestead exemption and the Real Property Tax Credit.
Separate from the refundable community-college income-tax credit.
Do not add to an already-net property-tax bill.

sources.title: Directive 25-4 — School District Property Tax Relief Credit

researchNotes: Statewide statement credits reduce the bill before payment and must not be added again to already-net tax inputs.
No direct renter credit was identified.
